claim_title: Sleeping under 6 hours a night can increase cholesterol
caption: **Short sleep and cholesterol.** The reviewed evidence doesn't line up behind this claim: the one supporting result came from **total sleep deprivation in rodents**, not people with mildly short nights, while the human studies mostly found lower HDL or no change in total cholesterol rather than a rise. The lab work was small and self-reported sleep is imprecise, so the evidence is mixed and cannot confirm the claim.
subtitle: The one supportive study was in rodents; human studies were mixed and mostly contradicted it.
